Create teanga-rs Rust library for Irish morphological validation
description:
Port the grammatach Python library to Rust for high-performance Irish morphological validation. This includes:
- Constraint system for morphological feature validation
- UD token wrapper for Universal Dependencies integration
- Irish mutation rules (lenition, eclipsis, prefix-h, prefix-t)
- Scottish Gaelic and Manx support (future phases)
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Cargo workspace with teanga-rs crate
- [ ] Constraint system matching Python behavior
- [ ] UD token wrapper with feature access
- [ ] Irish lenition rules (10.2.x)
- [ ] Irish eclipsis rules (10.6.x)
- [ ] Prefix-h and prefix-t rules (10.9-10.14)
- [ ] Unit tests with >80% coverage
- [ ] PyO3 bindings for Python integration
- [ ] WASM bindings for browser usage
close_reason: teanga-rs Rust library complete with 41 tests passing, PyO3 bindings, and WASM support

title: Create dlt source for Universal Dependencies treebanks
description:
Create a dlt source to ingest Celtic language treebanks from the Universal Dependencies project:
- UD_Irish-IDT (modern standard Irish)
- UD_Irish-TwittIrish (social media Irish)
- UD_Irish-Cadhan (pre-standard texts)
- UD_Scottish_Gaelic-ARCOSG
- UD_Welsh-CCG
- UD_Breton-KEB
- UD_Manx-Cadhan
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] CoNLL-U parser for .conllu files
- [ ] DLT source with incremental loading
- [ ] Schema for sentences, tokens, features
- [ ] Integration with DuckDB destination
- [ ] Dagster asset definition
- [ ] Tests with sample UD data
close_reason: DLT source created at sruth/oideachais/dlt_sources/ud_treebanks.py - supports Irish, Welsh, Scottish Gaelic, Breton treebanks

Create BAML schemas for Gaois APIs (Tearma, Dúchas, Logainm)

Create type-safe BAML schemas for extracting structured data from Gaois.ie APIs:
- Tearma.ie terminology database

- Logainm.ie placenames database

These schemas will enable LLM-powered extraction and validation of Irish language resources.
